<reason>B won the lead-time clash. PRO's early-nudge physics and 7-year dead-zone were strong, but CON showed characterization/scout delay applies to a standing bus too, plus diversity, obsolescence, cost and corridor politics. PRO overclaimed surveys as conceding the motion and relied on a dubious dual-use bus, with two clipped turns as execution cost.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B4.4 to B5.2 scout-first attack: if the heavy hitter cannot be aimed until a scout characterizes mass/spin/structure, a parked bus waits anyway and readiness buys upkeep not lead time, directly neutralizing PRO's year-one vs year-four claim.</best_rebuttal>
